method: Targeted web-assisted primary-literature discovery and source verification; not a systematic database review.
date_limits: None; historical primary studies intentionally included.
filters: Primary journal records, PubMed/PMC, publisher full text or institutional author manuscripts used for substantive evidence. Review hits used only as discovery leads.
count_limit: Search wrapper result counts were not independently enumerated; no exhaustive screening denominator claimed.

inclusion_decision: Retained sources directly separating trigger, susceptibility, output, automatic/voluntary inhibition, variability, sensory-action binding or adult applicability; selected counterevidence retained explicitly.
exclusion_decision: Did not use reviews, press releases, general websites or automatically generated summaries as causal evidence; did not promote inspected animal, computational or laboratory-task outcomes to human cure evidence.
access_limits: Some direct PMC/PubMed pages returned browser challenges, and publisher routes returned cache/redirect errors. Indexed primary text, institutional manuscripts and publisher HTML supplied verified material. These were access failures, not authorization denials. No paywall bypass was attempted.
privacy: Only original synthesis, bibliographic metadata and search queries retained. No participant-level rows or full-paper copies saved.
